elaine: 25m until all-hands. quick change: we’ll run people updates, then Q&A, then the roadmap. keeping Q&A earlier to handle overflow.
marco: noted. presenter slide deck updated 14/15 swap done.
devin: rehearsal flagged: OBS main scene had a freeze on my laptop. is there a fallback?
ops-bot: Live ingest OK. Recorder idle. Monitoring stream health.
karen: caption node-2 showing high latency. warming up alt model now: `/srv/captions/fast-start --model en-fast`.
marco: can someone confirm captions are enabled on the public watch page? last meeting they were off by default.
elaine: confirmed in the event doc; captions toggled on.
devin: mic check in 10. I have a headset ready as backup. can we also capture slide-only feed?
ops-bot: Slide-only capture started: sld-2061 (path: /mnt/rec/slides/2061.mp4).
marco: FYI disk /mnt/rec at 16% free. auto-rotation on. if split occurs use `/usr/local/bin/merge-recordings --src /mnt/rec/parts --dest /mnt/rec/final`.
karen: swapped caption model; median latency 320ms now. no errors in logs.
elaine: leadership will take Slido Qs. @marco please pin top 5 and DM any sensitive flags to me before showing.
devin: tiny troubleshooting snippet if OBS drops frames:
``n systemctl --user restart obs.service
journalctl --user -u obs.service --since "5 minutes ago" | tail -n 100
```
then paste logs here and we’ll triage.
marco: done with slide check and mic sanity. see you all in ~20.
